Yes, Jasmine Crockett received political contributions from Sam Bankman-Fried during her 2022 congressional campaign for Texas's 30th district. Sam Bankman-Fried, the disgraced former CEO of the cryptocurrency exchange FTX, and his brother Gabriel each donated $2,900 directly to Crockett’s campaign. Additionally, two super PACs associated with Bankman-Fried provided significant financial support: Protect Our Future PAC, primarily funded by Bankman-Fried, spent over $1.4 million, and Web3 Forward, which received funds from GMI PAC (also backed by Bankman-Fried), spent more than $1.3 million on her behalf, totaling over $2.7 million in outside spending to support her campaign, primarily through advertising and direct mail. Crockett has stated she was unaware of Bankman-Fried’s involvement with Protect Our Future or its crypto ties until reported by the media and noted that, by law, super PACs cannot coordinate directly with campaigns.
